exemptions.description: Vacation or recreational leases of 100 days or less
exemptions.quote: The provisions of this section shall not apply to any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of one hundred days or less in duration which lease or rental is for a vacation or recreational purpose.

key_values.name: max_security_deposit
key_values.text: a security deposit equal to the first month's rent

key_values.name: max_fee_in_lieu
key_values.text: to an amount not to exceed 1 month's rent

rules.penalty: Forfeiture of right to retain deposit; treble damages plus 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees (subsection 7).
rules.quote: At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following:
relations_hint: Any provision of a lease which conflicts with any provision of this section and any waiver by a tenant or prospective tenant of any provision of this section shall be deemed to be against public policy and therefore void and unenforceable.
rules.requirement: At or before tenancy start, a lessor may require only first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit equal to first month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock. Security deposit must be held per subsection (3) and a statement of condition given.
rules.title: Limit on upfront payments and security deposit
